game_concept: A action defense set in Snowy Hold – Hearth Hall, a warm hearth hall: the frost mage must handle frozen golems while practicing functions. Core idea – Keyword Switchboard: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches.
theme: Snowy Hold – Hearth Hall: a warm hearth hall
core_gameplay_loop: In Hearth Hall, repeat each round: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches. Each round, frozen golems strike the hearth fire, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the wires value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the hearth fire from frozen golems in Hearth Hall: keep the wires meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 31-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: wires drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 31-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 4 (applied tier): Keyword Switchboard
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wires changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frozen golems in Hearth Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 31 seconds while wires > 0.
